# scp01: leave camp coverage without leaving healing spawn

Base `2f0f534e8311ee597e516b11c2afca1bbf608060`, bot `leader_party_tuned`.
Candidate `bots/pi_spawn-camp-reposition-01/` only. Write IMPLEMENTATION.md.
PC builds/tests. Start from original champion, not rejected bge01/bce01 or
other experiments. One behavior change; preserve existing source policy.

## Evidence and hypothesis

Original Elkring/gold_diamond/B, baseline replay cd01-broad-baseline/00011.zip,
ends979-223 at2000. Exact original Heart6 pre-turn250/input4586/substep44:
at(27,27),940/1000HP,bag0, no enemy visible, no channel/restriction. Visible
awake elk1 at(26,23),range4,strength60 covers self. No enemy/camp target exists
in any of Heart's basic/spell masks. It ends turn without useful action.
The host permits seven adjacent moves; (27,28) and(28,28) are unoccupied,
within ownspawn, and outside the covering camp's range. Ally Vesper occupies
(28,27), Vendetta(29,27), so neither is a free alternative. Official map
symmetry/geometry verifies teamB spawn is x27..29,y27..29.

Original source chooses `spawn && threatened` before danger/healing/work.
Threatened is incoming>0 or camp_hit; defend only calls fight(world,-1).
That function cannot attack a camp with task=-1 and never moves. A camp can
therefore cover spawn while no actionable enemy exists, pinning useful actors.

Baseline census:64 screen games have no sampled defend dispatches;72 broad
common games contain36 pure100-dispatch defend windows across3games/7actors,
all Elkring.35/36 windows have bag0.20 have actual camp damage AND healing;
spawn is NOT immune. No collection/deposit/death/damage-dealt occurs during
those windows. Elkring accounts for6466 of6515 sampled broad defend dispatches;
Homonoliths has49. These are sampled intervals, not proof every frame is idle.

Separate rejected bge01 ElkringB at900 confirms same mechanism with
Heart(28,27),940HP and Vesper(27,27),full1000HP. Elk1 has497.260620HP.
Both have legal in-spawn zero-exposure neighbors and no legal attack/cast target.
Heart takes60damage then heals60 per round. This changed trajectory is
supporting mechanism evidence, not an independent baseline. bge01 itself
failed Elkring delivery374vs979 despite screen11/16direct,38/64commonvs33;
do not bundle its bank movement or claim this fixes all its missing income.

Hypothesis: after ordinary spawn defense, one walking step to a currently
zero-incoming tile INSIDE own spawn can end camp-only defensive idling while
retaining spawn recovery. Next turn ordinary state selection decides healing,
banking or work. This is local basic-damage avoidance, not a guarantee against
hidden enemies/future spells or proof that later ordinary camp work is safe.

## Exact isolated behavior

Add a small private implementation behind `spawn_camp_reposition(TurnBudget&)`
(name adjustable) in combat.cpp/.h, called only from State::defend AFTER the
existing fight(world,-1). Interface may return bool or existing RouteStatus;
caller does not need to know mask/threat details. No Memory argument or new
persistent state. No general navigation rewrite. Preserve defend_cast/fight
priority and all other state dispatch.

Capture whether the original defend-entry snapshot has NO visible foes before
calling fight; require that condition as well as the helper's fresh post-fight
check. Killing the last visible enemy must not newly enable this movement.
Do not interpret fight(false) as proof no action occurred: defend_cast can act
before fight returns false. Preserve its action and check remaining mobility.

1. Guard budget.current and fuel>Config::reserve; refresh observe after prior
   fight. Require same-round snapshot, alive, ownspawn, no channel, available
   movement, no movement restriction, s.foes.empty(), camp_hit, incoming>0.
   Empty visible foes is stricter than enemies==0; any visible foe vetoes.
2. Use current physical blocked mask and SDK reachable_tiles(pos,1), excluding
   self. Intersect exact SDK ally spawn mask. Do not add outside-spawn goals,
   dash, teleport, recall, attack, camp assignment or relaxed enemy policy.
3. Snapshot visible living awake positive-strength camps once, retaining exact
   incoming_at Chebyshev/range/strength semantics and iteration order. Since
   current foes must be empty, no champion contribution is omitted. Avoid
   repeated SDK scans for each of at most8 neighbors. Keep this local; no
   global cache or change to observations/incoming_at. Guard round/fuel during
   collection, list construction and before any action; do not claim queries
   are atomic across fuel suspension.
4. A candidate must have estimated incoming EXACTLY ZERO from that same local
   captured camp set. Require current origin incoming>0 from this set too.
   Do not accept merely lower positive exposure. Rank admitted neighbors by
   deterministic(y,x), with no extra distance field or path search. At most
   eight adjacent candidates. If no zero-exposure ownspawn tile exists, do
   nothing; preserve original behavior. Allies/camps/physical blockers remain
   excluded. SDK movement convention governs diagonals; no invented rule.
5. Immediately before the one move_checked attempt, recheck current/fuel,
   life/channel/can_move/restrictions. Only report success on actual movement.
   Preserve move_checked invalidation/error handling; hidden blocker means
   one rejected attempt, no second retry. No memory/task/altar/distance/counter
   mutation and no field quota use. The next ordinary turn reassesses state.

Preserve roster, items, camp selection, task lifetime, bag/bankage/recovery
thresholds, original movement, enemy defense, queue/channel rules, optional
wards, reporting and coordination. No map-name/actor-specific branch. Do not
change spawn-threat classification globally; the action is confined to defend.

## Focused correctness checks

Exercise actual production helper and actual State::defend integration through
controlled host/dependency substitutes if needed. Do not copy predicates.
Use realSDK wrappers/syntax and retain existing native state tests. Cover:

- Original-style wounded Heart, covering ranged camp, no reachable enemy,
  free zero-exposure ownspawn tile: exactlyone legal walking action. Existing
  fight executes first; no Memory/task mutation, no field spent.
- Enemy visible but farther than6 vetoes; enemy in range gets original defense;
  enemy present at entry but killed by original fight still vetoes reposition;
  absent camp exposure/zeroorigin incoming/outside spawn vetoes.
- Only outside-spawn safe tiles, all in-spawn occupied, or only positive-but-
  lower incoming candidates: no action. Sleeping/dead/zero-strength camps do
  not create false risk. Multiple covering camps; deterministic coordinate tie.
- Dead/channel/immobile/restricted guard; spent movement after original fight;
  fuel reserve/round rollover while observing/collecting/enumerating/pre-action;
  hidden blocker rejects one attempt and invalidates without claiming success.
- Already-healing state and other ordinary states never call the helper;
  original survivor/camp/bank behavior unchanged except subsequent trajectories.

Document substitute-geometry limitations and realSDK syntax results. No release
logging. PC establishes official legality, real branch exposure, fuel and wins.
